required_checks_in_fixture: Focused owned windows A and B must both capture successfully and match their distinct known surface colors.
Capture receipts identify the selected window and use hyprland-toplevel-export, window-local coordinates, and image dimensions matching the saved PNG.
Each pixel/logical ratio is checked against actual image dimensions and logicalRegion. Window scale must remain stable across the focus transition.
Capturing A while B is focused must not steal focus from B.
If A retains its observed placement and monitor, its background capture must succeed. An observed placement change permits only a bounded explicit failure that preserves the prior destination.
A closed window ID must fail as stale/unavailable while preserving an existing destination and leaving the other owned window mapped.
boundaries: The requested scale was 1.25; the fixture did not require the effective ratio to equal 1.25.
The retained summary does not identify which allowed background-capture branch was exercised.
The physical-input/KMS descriptor checks inspect the owned compositor processes; an explicit renderD node is a separate supported runner input.
This is one private native capture gate, not a claim about every host desktop window, all application operations, or full game completion.
The builder and runner sources are delivered; archives, images, logs and compiled binaries remain outside Git.
